arguments.text: 8 km, 8 legs of 1000 m out-and-back. Settle from the hard start to about critical power (pod about 195-205 W) by minute 3. Hold near critical power through the middle, a little more on legs against the current, a little less with it. Keep pod reserve above about 30 pct until 2 km to go, then spend it: build from 1500 m to go, finish cue at about 400 m to go. Watch for instrument drift (pod vs boat model disagree), rudder fouling (speed drop at same power), and radio course changes.
